mentions.name: Nitor
mentions.description: A Discord-style chat platform with a shared/federated identity layer and self-hosted servers/guilds. The trust model trusts the guild server so private channels work normally with moderation capabilities, while E2E DMs and friend/presence systems are enabled using guild servers as relays. Built with Rust, Iced, and Iroh.
mentions.source_excerpt: Nitor - a discord clone with a shared/federated Identity layer, but self-hosted "servers/guilds". Trust model is to trust the guild server (e.g., so private channels work as one would expect with moderation capabilities), but to enable E2E DMs and friend/presence systems via guild servers as relays. Rust, Iced, Iroh.
